content: {"episode_id":"ep-05045","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 Mobile Cardiac Telemetry was denied under CO-197 for lack of precertification, yet the clinical indication documents a patient with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42) accompanied by a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9) and known sick sinus syndrome (I49.5). Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or conduction abnormalities that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring, as stated in the indication note. This documentation is submitted as the supporting clinical justification of medical necessity requested in the SilverBridge Advantage letter, and we ask that the CO-197 denial be overturned and the claim reprocessed."}
